name: room-label-style
description: Room-name label rotation + font-size styling (PARITY-ROOMLABEL-STYLE / FEATURE_PARITY row 111). Opens the plan editor, rotates a room label and enlarges its font via updateRoom, and screenshots the 2D plan so the angled, bigger label is visible.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: style-a-label
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; s.updateRoom(r.id, { labelAngle: Math.PI/6, labelFontScale: 1.6 }); s.setPlanSelection({ type:'room', id:r.id }); window.__rid = r.id; })()
